mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT * FROM MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT * FROM MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS = '0' AND (NEXT_EXECUTE_TIME IS NULL OR NEXT_EXECUTE_TIME <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.ID = MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK.REQUEST_ID AND ((r.CHANGE_TYPE IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE') AND r.ITEM_COUNT = 1) OR (r.CHANGE_TYPE IN ('BATCH_UPDATE', 'STATUS_CHANGE', 'BATCH_IMPORT') AND r.ITEM_COUNT BETWEEN 1 AND 500)) AND r.STATUS = '1' AND r.EXECUTE_STATUS = '0' AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) ORDER BY ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK SET TASK_STATUS = '1', WORKER_ID = #{workerId}, START_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, LEASE_UNTIL = #{leaseUntil}, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS = '0' AND (NEXT_EXECUTE_TIME IS NULL OR NEXT_EXECUTE_TIME <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK SET TASK_STATUS = '2', SUCCESS_COUNT = #{successCount}, FAIL_COUNT = 0, FINISH_TIME = #{finishTime}, WORKER_ID = NULL, LEASE_UNTIL = NULL, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS = '1' AND WORKER_ID = #{workerId}

UPDATE MASTER_EXECUTE_TASK SET TASK_STATUS = #{taskStatus}, FAIL_COUNT = #{failCount}, RETRY_COUNT = #{retryCount}, NEXT_EXECUTE_TIME = #{nextExecuteTime}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, WORKER_ID = NULL, LEASE_UNTIL = NULL, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS = '1' AND WORKER_ID = #{workerId}
